title: Transaction banking account migration go live requested
description: This event occurs when a go-live is requested for a migrated account. It is emitted by bank-statements-migration-worker after processing a go-live request.

external_account_id.title: External Account ID
external_account_id.description: Custom account ID that uniquely identifies the account within your organization.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status of the go-live request. Indicates the result of the go-live processing.

code.title: Code
code.description: Response code for the go-live operation. Populated on ERROR status.

message.title: Message
message.description: Response message for the go-live operation. Populated on ERROR status with detailed error description.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Unique ID used to identify the program in the Pismo platform APIs.
